title: Dasakam 9
description: Brahma searches for the source of the lotus, turns inward in meditation, beholds Narayana on Adishesha, receives instruction, and begins creation.

stanzas.sanskrit:
स्थितः स कमलोद्भवस्तव हि नाभिपङ्केरुहे
कुतः स्विदिदमम्बुधावुदितमित्यनालोकयन् ।
तदीक्षणकुतूहलात् प्रतिदिशं विवृत्तानन-
-श्चतुर्वदनतामगाद्विकसदष्टदृष्ट्यम्बुजाम् ॥ ९-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma sitting on the full bloomed lotus emerging from Bhagwan’s lotus-like navel, and wondering about its origin looked all around by turning his face in all the directions. He was thus endowed with four faces and lotus-like eight beautiful eyes.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sthitaḥ sa kamalodbhavastava hi nābhipaṅkeruhe
kutaḥ svididamambudhāvuditamityanālokayan |
tadīkṣaṇakutūhalāt pratidiśaṃ vivṛttānana-
-ścaturvadanatāmagādvikasadaṣṭadṛṣṭyambujām || 9-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
महार्णवविघूर्णितं कमलमेव तत् केवलं
विलोक्य तदुपाश्रयं तव तनुं तु नालोकयन् ।
क एष कमलोदरे महति निस्सहायो ह्यहं
कुतः स्विदिदमम्बुजं समजनीति चिन्तामगात् ॥ ९-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma found himself to be all alone in the huge lotus which was tossing about in the vast ocean of causal waters. He saw the stem supporting the lotus but was unable to see Bhagwan’s body and wondered about the source of the lotus.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
mahārṇavavighūrṇitaṃ kamalameva tat kevalaṃ
vilokya tadupāśrayaṃ tava tanuṃ tu nālokayan |
ka eṣa kamalodare mahati nissahāyo hyahaṃ
kutaḥ svididamambujaṃ samajanīti cintāmagāt || 9-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अमुष्य हि सरोरुहः किमपि कारणं सम्भवे-
-दिति स्म कृतनिश्चयः स खलु नालरन्ध्राध्वना ।
स्वयोगबलविद्यया समवरूढवान् प्रौढधीः
त्वदीयमतिमोहनं न तु कलेवरं दृष्टवान् ॥ ९-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma who was of mighty intellect, decided that there must definitely be some source of this lotus. Using his yogic power he descended through the hollow of the lotus stem to look for the cause. He, however could not see Bhagwan’s most enchanting form.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
amuṣya hi saroruhaḥ kimapi kāraṇaṃ sambhave-
-diti sma kṛtaniścayaḥ sa khalu nālarandhrādhvanā |
svayogabalavidyayā samavarūḍhavān prauḍhadhīḥ
tvadīyamatimohanaṃ na tu kalevaraṃ dṛṣṭavān || 9-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
ततः सकलनालिकाविवरमार्गगो मार्गयन्
प्रयस्य शतवत्सरं किमपि नैव सन्दृष्टवान् ।
निवृत्य कमलोदरे सुखनिषण्ण एकाग्रधीः
समाधिबलमादधे भवदनुग्रहैकाग्रही ॥ ९-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma spent a hundred divine years strenuously searching through all the orifices of the lotus stem but he could not see anything. He returned to the lotus and sat calmly with one pointed concentration and resorted to deep samaadhi solely desirous of Bhagwan’s grace.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tataḥ sakalanālikāvivaramārgago mārgayan
prayasya śatavatsaraṃ kimapi naiva sandṛṣṭavān |
nivṛtya kamalodare sukhaniṣaṇṇa ekāgradhīḥ
samādhibalamādadhe bhavadanugrahaikāgrahī || 9-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
शतेन परिवत्सरैर्दृढसमाधिबन्धोल्लसत्
प्रबोध विशदीकृतः स खलु पद्मिनीसम्भवः ।
अदृष्टचरमद्भुतं तव हि रूपमन्तर्दृशा
व्यचष्ट परितुष्टधीर्भुजगभोगभागाश्रयम् ॥ ९-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The lotus born Brahma was absorbed in undisturbed samaadhi for a hundred divine years.The knowledge of Reality then dawned on him. He then had the vision of Bhagwan’s wonderful form which humans cannot easily see, resting on a part of Aadishesha's body. So he was full of happiness and contentment.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śatena parivatsarairdṛḍhasamādhibandhollasat
prabodha viśadīkṛtaḥ sa khalu padminīsambhavaḥ |
adṛṣṭacaramadbhutaṃ tava hi rūpamantardṛśā
vyacaṣṭa parituṣṭadhīrbhujagabhogabhāgāśrayam || 9-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
किरीटमकुटोल्लसत्कटकहारकेयूरयु-
-ङ्मणिस्फुरितमेखलं सुपरिवीतपीताम्बरम् ।
कलायकुसुमप्रभं गलतलोल्लसत् कौस्तुभं
वपुस्तदयि भावये कमलजन्मने दर्शितम् ॥ ९-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri worshipped that divine form of Bhagwan, with a brilliant colour like a blue lily, sparkling like the Kalaya flower, decked with golden crown, bracelets, necklaces and shoulder ornaments, wearing yellow coloured silk garment, gold studded waist band and shining Kausthubh jewel round the neck.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kirīṭamakuṭollasatkaṭakahārakeyūrayu-
-ṅmaṇisphuritamekhalaṃ suparivītapītāmbaram |
kalāyakusumaprabhaṃ galatalollasat kaustubhaṃ
vapustadayi bhāvaye kamalajanmane darśitam || 9-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
श्रुतिप्रकरदर्शितप्रचुरवैभव श्रीपते
हरे जय जय प्रभो पदमुपैषि दिष्ट्या दृशोः ।
कुरुष्व धियमाशु मे भुवननिर्मितौ कर्मठा-
-मिति द्रुहिणवर्णितस्वगुणबंहिमा पाहि माम् ॥ ९-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma felt it is his good fortune that Bhagwan have revealed HIS sacred form to him. Brahma wished to make his intelligence capable of creating the world. Brahma praised Bhagwan for the innumerable excellences and pleased to be merciful to protect him.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śrutiprakadarśitapracuravaibhava śrīpate
hare jaya jaya prabho padamupaiṣi diṣṭyā dṛśoḥ |
kuruṣva dhiyamāśu me bhuvananirmitau karmaṭhā-
-miti druhiṇavarṇitasvaguṇabaṃhimā pāhi mām || 9-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
लभस्व भुवनत्रयीरचनदक्षतामक्षतां
गृहाण मदनुग्रहं कुरु तपश्च भूयो विधे ।
भवत्वखिलसाधनी मयि च भक्तिरत्युत्कटे-
-त्युदीर्य गिरमादधा मुदितचेतसं वेधसम् ॥ ९-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan blessed Brahma to be endowed with unending capability and expertise in the creation of the three worlds & his devotion to excel. Bhagwan guided to do penance again by which he will accomplish everything. So saying Bhagwan made Brahma's mind immensely happy.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
labhasva bhuvanatrayīracanadakṣatāmakṣatāṃ
gṛhāṇa madanugrahaṃ kuru tapaśca bhūyo vidhe |
bhavatvakhilasādhanī mayi ca bhaktiratyutkaṭe-
-tyudīrya giramādadhā muditacetasaṃ vedhasam || 9-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
शतं कृततपास्ततः स खलु दिव्यसंवत्सरा-
-नवाप्य च तपोबलं मतिबलं च पूर्वाधिकम् ।
उदीक्ष्य किल कम्पितं पयसि पङ्कजं वायुना
भवद्बलविजृम्भितः पवनपाथसी पीतवान् ॥ ९-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: With tapas  for another 100 divine years, Brahma gathered spiritual and mental powers to start creation of three worlds and other beings. The Lotus swayed in the casual waters and he drank wind and water.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śataṃ kṛtatapāstataḥ sa khalu divyasaṃvatsarā-
-navāpya ca tapobalaṃ matibalaṃ ca pūrvādhikam |
udīkṣya kila kampitaṃ payasi paṅkajaṃ vāyunā
bhavadbalavijṛmbhitaḥ pavanapāthasī pītavān || 9-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तवैव कृपया पुनः सरसिजेन तेनैव सः
प्रकल्प्य भुवनत्रयीं प्रववृते प्रजानिर्मितौ ।
तथाविधकृपाभरो गुरुमरुत्पुराधीश्वर
त्वमाशु परिपाहि मां गुरुदयोक्षितैरीक्षितैः ॥ ९-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma, then, by Bhagwan’s grace created the three worlds out of that lotus itself and got engaged in creating the various species of beings. Bhattathiri requested Bhagwan to bestow on him, mercy and cure his ailments. Bhagwan acknowledged his request immediately.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tavaiva kṛpayā punaḥ sarasijena tenaiva saḥ
prakalpya bhuvanatrayīṃ pravavṛte prajānirmitau |
tathāvidhakṛpābharo gurumarutpurādhīśvara
tvamāśu paripāhi māṃ gurudayokṣitairīkṣitaiḥ || 9-10 ||
